name: What kind of warranties should I expect with a new roof replacement?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranties should I expect with a new roof replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new roof replacement typically comes with two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty on the materials and a contractor's warranty on the workmanship. Manufacturer warranties often range from 20-50 years, depending on the material. Workmanship warranties vary, but typically cover installation errors for a period of 5-10 years. Understanding the specifics of both warranties is part of preparation; ensure you receive clear documentation outlining coverage details and any requirements for maintaining validity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a manufacturer's warranty on materials (20-50 years) and a contractor's warranty on workmanship (5-10 years). Understand all coverage details.
